description: This file defines a PHP class 'Ip' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Fraud'. It contains methods for managing IP addresses related to fraud detection, including listing, adding, removing, installing, and uninstalling IP-related configurations. The class extends a core Controller class and interacts with language, URL, model, and response components of the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class for managing IP addresses related to fraud detection within the OpenCart admin extension. Provides CRUD operations, installation, and uninstallation of IP monitoring features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main IP management page, loads language resources, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the IP view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves IP-related settings, either modifying configuration or updating the database with posted data, returns a JSON response.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Runs installation routines for the fraud IP extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Runs uninstallation routines for the fraud IP extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Displays a paginated list of IP addresses detected by the fraud system, showing associated customer data.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the system after validating permissions and input; responds with success or error in JSON.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the system after permission check, responding with success or error in JSON.
